notes: Borderlands 4 has its own per-game AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 plus 4 supporting keys (coords write, main-thread call intercept, post-process write, GUObjectArray). Per-game pattern is preferred; shared UE5 SSE variant is fallback. Ships with EAC -- verify offline mode before injecting.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_ue5_sse_fallback

camera_write_profile._comment: Per-game pattern reads source from rbx and writes to rdi. Verify register snapshot via __cam_intercept_capture before enabling trajectory playback. UE5 LWC: Location FVector3d (3 doubles) at 0x00, Rotation FRotator (3 floats) at 0x18, FOV at 0x24 -- VERIFY for OakGame UE5.
